# account balance

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountBalance`](gmeow-accountBalance.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountBalance>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The current balance of a financial account, expressed as a [`MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md). Non-functional: a multi-currency account has several balances, and competing standpoint-indexed balance claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
